text.tspan: To enter the giveaway, make a deposit of at least $10 and collect tickets daily on the
Lucky Drive promotion page in the Free money section. Each ticket gives you one entry into
the giveaway. The more tickets you collect, the higher your chances of winning.
- Rolex Datejust — to 5 random participants who collect 6+ tickets in a row
- MacBook Pro 14’’ M3 — to 25 random participants
- iPhone 18 Pro Max — to 25 random participants
- Free spins — to all participants who collected 7+ tickets
- 10,000 USDT — to one random participant who made at least one cryptocurrency deposit
The number of free spins depends on the number of tickets collected:
The general terms and conditions of the promotion are available in the Rules section.
